title: EAGLE plugin sidecar (schema v1 to v3)
description: Schema for the per-artifact JSON sidecar a code generator writes next to a compiled kernel (v1 through v3). A sidecar describes one plugin's launch signature: a shared base plus one of two pattern-specific variants (vector | pure). arg_spec is the ordered list of [role, name] pairs a loader binds; every role must be one of the 12 canonical roles enumerated inline (plugin/roles.h::kPluginArgRoles ≡ eagle.roles.ROLES). v2 adds the execution axis (exec_targets, exec_access, exec_op) and the tag aether-abi/2; v3 is v2 with the cells record. Validators are backward-lenient (absent schema_version ⇒ v1) and forward-strict (an unknown role, or a schema_version newer than the loader, ⇒ rejected). Unknown/future top-level keys are tolerated (additionalProperties true) so a future minor revision may add keys — including populating the reserved launch surface — without a schema_version bump.

schema_version.description: Plugin-schema version this sidecar conforms to (raptor.schema.manifest.MAX_SCHEMA_VERSION is the newest). Absent ⇒ treated as v1 (backward-lenient); newer than the loader ⇒ rejected (forward-strict). Selects the aether_abi tag and whether the execution axis is carried (see the conditional blocks).

format.description: Artifact format the sidecar accompanies: arch-portable PTX, single-arch cubin, multi-arch fatbin, or host (a host shared library).

pattern.description: Plugin family — selects the variant-specific required fields (see the conditional blocks). A loader refuses the wrong artifact family; an unknown OR absent pattern is a hard error (strict).

aether_abi.description: Binary-ABI tag of the by-value GRef / HandleT POD mirrors the artifact was built against: aether-abi/1 with schema v1, aether-abi/2 with v2 and v3 (see the conditional blocks). A loader rejects a mismatch before binding any by-value struct.

scalar_type.description: Real scalar type the kernel was compiled for.

kernel.description: The extern-"C" entry-point symbol the loader resolves in the artifact: always "raptor_kernel", the name raptor's schema fixes for every producer, hand-written kernels included.

vector_inputs.description: Named vector inputs, in binding order (mirrors the vec_in arg_spec roles).

params.description: Named uniform scalar parameters (bound via the uniform role): bare names, or {name, dtype} entries when params_schema is 2.

per_sample.description: Named per-sample scalar inputs (bound via the per_sample role).

exec_targets.description: v2 and v3: the entry kinds the artifact provides.

exec_access.description: v2 and v3: how the body touches sample-local versus cross-sample data.

exec_op.description: v2 and v3: the reduction operator; present exactly when exec_access is mapreduce.

params_schema.description: Wire version of the params block; 2 means decl-carrying {name, dtype} entries.

arg_shapes.description: Per-name flat width of every plane-bound slot; null for a runtime-length plane.

arg_dtypes.description: Per-name wire dtype of every plane-bound slot.

dispatch.description: Per-kernel dispatch groups: name, K, policy, static_selector and the selector's read slots.

quantities.description: Per-quantity list of the wires it spans.

plane_axes.description: Per sink declared with named axes: its payload shape and the axes it is bound over.

terminated_readonly.description: Whether the kernel only reads the terminated mask.

host_entry.description: The host entry-point symbol, for an artifact with a host entry.

digest.description: Digest of the kernel body the artifact was built from.

aether_include.description: Provenance: the aether header root (or a sealed-payload marker) the kernel was built against.

eagle_include.description: Provenance: the eagle header root (or a sealed-payload marker) the kernel was built against.

accumulate.description: Vector only: whether the sink (out) uses the outVec `+=` accumulate idiom.

sink.description: Vector only: the accumulate sink contract name (e.g. "outVec-scratch") — a per-kernel deterministic-reduce scratch slot, not the final total.

matrix_inputs.description: Pure only, and only when the kernel has matrix inputs: the mat_in binding order (mirrors vector_inputs).

derivative.description: Optional, additive schema-v1 field (no version bump): present only for a VJP/JVP derivative artifact (autodiff, generated or custom — structurally indistinguishable). Metadata only; the artifact still launches as an ordinary pure kernel. Recompute-only in v1, so residual_policy is 'recompute' and residuals is []; a populated residuals list is a future revision that bumps schema_version and is rejected by a v1 loader.

role.description: The 12 canonical arg-spec roles. Single source of truth: plugin/roles.h::kPluginArgRoles ≡ eagle.roles.ROLES (cross-checked by python/tests/test_roles_vocab.py). A loader rejects any role outside this set at LOAD time (forward-strict). Note: mat_in is a valid role recognized by every loader, but the reference C++ host inject() does not pack matrix arguments (a CUDA-backend capability).

argSpec.description: Ordered list of [role, name] pairs (role FIRST) the loader binds in sequence.

prefixItems.description: The argument name (a vector_input / param / per_sample / mutable / buffer name, or a fixed slot name such as "out"/"terminated"/"nsamples").

vecWidths.description: Per-name vector width (component count) so a host can allocate (W, N) buffers; the GRef struct itself is width-independent. Present on both variants.

buffers.description: Declared read-only lookup buffers (the consolidation contract). Present on both variants. May be empty.

buffer.description: One read-only lookup buffer the registry uploads once at consolidation and binds by value as a flat handle.

mutables.description: Pure only: the writable per-sample state that IS the pure output.

mutable.description: One writable per-sample slot. dtype/width let a loader rebuild which Mutables ride the (W, N) GRef ABI vs a flat scalar handle; the optional default fills an omitted Mutable. A matrix slot additionally carries its (R, C) shape.

width.description: Flat component count (1 for a scalar).

prior.description: The body reads this slot's launch-start value, so the host must preserve it between launches.

default.description: Scalar fill value for an omitted mutable (null when none).

shape.description: The (R, C) shape — present ONLY when dtype == "matrix" (the flat width alone cannot be un-flattened).

matShapes.description: Pure only, and only when the kernel has matrix inputs: the (R, C) shape per matrix-input name.

launch.description: Launch configuration. `block`, `box` and `lane_space` are populated; `shmem_bytes` and `grid` stay reserved (loaders ignore them). Keys are added without a schema_version bump. additionalProperties is true so unknown/future launch keys do not fail validation.

block.description: The exact number of threads per block the artifact was emitted for. Required for an artifact that uses a thread/block box; the loader launches with it verbatim.

box.description: A thread box: each thread computes T lanes that differ only along lane axis `axis`, `stride` flat lanes apart. A launch of n lanes runs ceil(n / (T * stride)) * stride threads, and the launch's base and count count threads while the lane count stays n.

axis.description: Position of the boxed axis in lane_space.axes.

stride.description: Flat-lane distance between two lanes of one box's axis step.

lane_space.description: The logical shape of the kernel's flat sample axis. axes is row-major and the LAST axis is the fastest; memory stays the flat n = product of the extents. Only the first axis may have a null extent (known at run time); every later extent is fixed. label is null for an unlabeled axis; non-null labels are unique. group is the compaction unit: a lane count, 1 by default.
